arxiv-1710-03874.title: Collisional damping rates for plasma waves
arxiv-1710-03874.creator: S. F. Tigik, L. F. Ziebell, P. H. Yoon
arxiv-1710-03874.description: Abstract The distinction between the plasma dynamics dominated by collisional transport versus collective processes has never been rigorously addressed until recently. A recent paper [Yoon et al., Phys. Rev. E 93 , 033203 (2016)] formulates for the first time, a unified kinetic theory in which collective processes and collisional dynamics are systematically incorporated from first principles.

arxiv-2008-13474.title: A Cost-Effective Person-Following System for Assistive Unmanned Vehicles with Deep Learning at the Edge
arxiv-2008-13474.creator: Anna Boschi, Francesco Salvetti, Vittorio Mazzia, and Marcello Chiaberge
arxiv-2008-13474.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Anna Boschi, Francesco Salvetti, Vittorio Mazzia, and Marcello Chiaberge. The vital statistics of the last century highlight a sharp increment of the average age of the world population with a consequent growth of the number of older people. Service robotics applications have the potentiality to provide systems and tools to support the autonomous and self-sufficient older adults in their houses in everyday life, thereby avoiding the task of monitoring them with third parties.

arxiv-2202-10105.title: On the limiting amplitude principle for the wave equation with variable coefficients
arxiv-2202-10105.creator: Anton Arnold 1 , Sjoerd Geevers 2 , Ilaria Perugia 2 , Dmitry Ponomarev 1,3,4
arxiv-2202-10105.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove new results on the validity of the limiting amplitude principle (LAP) for the wave equation with nonconstant coefficients, not necessarily in divergence form. Under suitable assumptions on the coefficients and on the source term, we establish the LAP for space dimensions 2 and 3.

arxiv-2204-13634.title: Experimental implementation of quantum algorithm for association rules mining
arxiv-2204-13634.creator: Chao-Hua Yu
arxiv-2204-13634.description: Abstract Recently, a quantum algorithm for a fundamentally important task in data mining, association rules mining (ARM), called qARM for short, has been proposed. Notably, qARM achieves significant speedup over its classical counterpart for implementing the main task of ARM, i.e., finding frequent itemsets from a transaction database.

arxiv-2305-00689.title: General Distance Balancing for Quantum Locally Testable Codes
arxiv-2305-00689.creator: Adam Wills, Ting-Chun Lin, Min-Hsiu Hsieh
arxiv-2305-00689.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove a lower bound on the soundness of quantum locally testable codes under the distance balancing construction of Evra et al. [ 1 ] . Our technical contribution is that the new soundness of the quantum code is at least the old soundness divided by the classical code length (up to a constant factor).

arxiv-2310-07493.title: Diversity for Contingency: Learning Diverse Behaviors for Efficient Adaptation and Transfer
arxiv-2310-07493.creator: Finn Rietz, Johannes A. Stork
arxiv-2310-07493.description: Abstract Discovering all useful solutions for a given task is crucial for transferable RL agents, to account for changes in the task or transition dynamics. This is not considered by classical RL algorithms that are only concerned with finding the optimal policy, given the current task and dynamics.

arxiv-2310-18273.title: Moments for Perceptive Narration Analysis Through the Audience’s Emotional Attachment to Discourse and Story
arxiv-2310-18273.creator: Gary Bruins, Ergun Akleman
arxiv-2310-18273.description: Abstract In this work, our goal is to develop a theoretical framework that can eventually be used for analyzing the effectiveness of visual stories such as feature films to comic books. To develop this theoretical framework, we introduce a new story element called moments.

arxiv-2407-06350.title: A Surrogate Endpoint Based Provisional Approval Causal Roadmap
arxiv-2407-06350.creator: Peter B. Gilbert, James Peng, Larry Han, Theis Lange, Yun Lu, Lei Nie, Mei-Chiung Shih, Salina P. Waddy, Ken Wiley, Margot Yann, Zafar Zafari, Debashis Ghosh, Dean Follmann, Michal Juraska, Iván Díaz
arxiv-2407-06350.description: Abstract For many rare diseases with no approved preventive interventions, promising interventions exist, yet it has been difficult to conduct a pivotal phase 3 trial that could provide direct evidence demonstrating a beneficial effect on the target disease outcome. When a promising putative surrogate endpoint(s) for the target outcome is available, surrogate-based provisional approval of an intervention may be pursued.

arxiv-2412-09748.title: New Approach to Clustering Random Attributes
arxiv-2412-09748.creator: Zenon Gniazdowski
arxiv-2412-09748.description: Abstract This paper proposes a new method for similarity analysis and, consequently, a new algorithm for clustering different types of random attributes, both numerical and nominal. However, in order for nominal attributes to be clustered, their values must be properly encoded. In the encoding process, nominal attributes obtain a new representation in numerical form.

arxiv-2503-05318.title: Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Minimum Bayes Risk
arxiv-2503-05318.creator: Nico Daheim, Clara Meister, Thomas Möllenhoff, Iryna Gurevych, Technical University of Darmstadt ETH Zurich
arxiv-2503-05318.description: Abstract Despite their outstanding performance in the majority of scenarios, contemporary language models still occasionally generate undesirable outputs, for example, hallucinated text. While such behaviors have previously been linked to uncertainty, there is a notable lack of methods that actively consider uncertainty during text generation.

arxiv-2504-19033.title: Connecting Weakly Nonlinear Elasticity Theories of Isotropic Hyperelastic Materials Thanks: Citation : Du, Y., Hill, N. A., & Luo, X. (2024). Connecting weakly nonlinear elasticity theories of isotropic hyperelastic materials. Mathematics and Mechanics of Solids, 29(9), 1900-1914.
arxiv-2504-19033.creator: Yangkun Du, Nicholas A Hill, Xiaoyu Luo
arxiv-2504-19033.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yangkun Du, Nicholas A Hill, Xiaoyu Luo. Soft materials exhibit significant nonlinear geometric deformations and stress-strain relationships under external forces. This paper explores weakly nonlinear elasticity theories, including Landau’s and Murnaghan’s formulations, advancing understanding beyond linear elasticity.

arxiv-2506-05243.title: CLATTER: Comprehensive Entailment Reasoning for Hallucination Detection
arxiv-2506-05243.creator: Ron Eliav 1 Arie Cattan 1 Eran Hirsch 1 Shahaf Bassan 2 Elias Stengel-Eskin 3 Mohit Bansal 3 Ido Dagan 1
arxiv-2506-05243.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ron Eliav 1 Arie Cattan 1 Eran Hirsch 1 Shahaf Bassan 2 Elias Stengel-Eskin 3 Mohit Bansal 3 Ido Dagan 1. A common approach to hallucination detection casts it as a natural language inference (NLI) task, often using LLMs to classify whether the generated text is entailed by corresponding reference texts. Since entailment classification is a complex reasoning task, one would expect that LLMs could benefit from generating an explicit reasoning process, as in CoT reasoning or the explicit “thinking” of recent reasoning models.

pmc-10605318.creator: Syed Mujtaba, Ishan Kumar Patro, Nisha Patro
pmc-10605318.description: Cumulative exposure to multiple early life stressors is expected to affect behavioral development, causing increased susceptibility to neuropsychiatric disorders. The present study was designed to mimic such conditions in a rat model to study behavioral impairments during adolescence and adulthood.

pmc-12470310.title: Pollination of Enclosed Avocado Trees by Blow Flies (Diptera: Calliphoridae) and a Hover Fly (Diptera: Syrphidae)
pmc-12470310.creator: David F. Cook, Muhammad S. Tufail, Elliot T. Howse, Sasha C. Voss, Jacinta Foley, Ben Norrish, Neil Delroy
pmc-12470310.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryAlthough flies regularly visit flowers, little research has gone into their pollination ability on commercial crops. An Australian project aimed to identify fly pollinators to secure insect pollinators into the future with a particular focus on avocados. This study investigated the ability of two calliphorids (Calliphora dubia and Calliphora vicina) and a syrphid (Eristalis tenax) fly (all found across Australia) to pollinate Hass avocados in south-western Australia.

pmc-12546323.title: Differential expression profiles of immunoregulatory genes in anaplastic thyroid carcinomas with a coexistent papillary carcinoma component
pmc-12546323.creator: Giulia Orlando, Francesca Napoli, Vanessa Zambelli, Francesca Maletta, Giulia Capella, Eleonora Duregon, Marco Volante, Mauro Papotti
pmc-12546323.description: Limited data exist on the immunoregulatory mechanisms involv ed in thyroid cancer, particularly in aggressive forms. This study aimed at identifying the expression profiles of immune-related genes and miRNAs in anaplastic (ATC) and poorly differentiated thyroid carcinomas (PDTC) associated with papillary carcinoma (PTC) components.

pmc-12617874.title: Protocol for research examination of individual suicides occurring in chronic pain: A qualitative approach to psychological autopsy methodology
pmc-12617874.creator: Stefan G Kertesz, Allyson L Varley, April E Hoge, Thomas E Joiner, Beth D Darnall, Kate M Nicholson, Lera A Fuqua, Mary F Gilmore, Kevin R Riggs, Stephanie A Gamble, Adam J Gordon, Yogesh Dwivedi, Mark Flower, Christin S Veasley, Carla Stumpf Patton, Ashley S Leal, Dawn M Gibson, James E Elliott, Me
pmc-12617874.description: IntroductionIn the United States, taper and discontinuation of opioids prescribed for long-term pain have emerged as statistical correlates of suicidal events. Suicide is a complex and multidetermined event reflecting a combination of risks occurring over time in a particular narrative context.

pmc-12730113.title: From 60 Causes to 10 Solutions Against Antibiotics Shortages in Sweden: Platinea’s Approach to Developing Policy Interventions
pmc-12730113.creator: Enrico Baraldi, Håkan Hanberger, Sofia Wagrell, Darko Modun
pmc-12730113.description: Background/Objectives: Antibiotic shortages are a growing problem which harms patient safety, increases healthcare costs, and accelerates antibiotic resistance. Based on the example of Sweden, the paper aims to illustrate and discuss how an organized collaboration platform can devise several policy interventions against shortages of antibiotics for human use.

pmc-13072652.title: The sources of suicidal ambivalence: favorable and risk factors for suicidal ideation among higher vocational college freshmen–a large sample survey
pmc-13072652.creator: Xi Lu, Kee Jiar Yeo, Ou Wu
pmc-13072652.description: BackgroundSuicidal ideation (SI) is a critical public health issue, particularly among college freshmen navigating significant life transitions. Higher vocational college students in China represent an understudied population facing unique academic, social, and employment pressures, which may elevate their suicide risk.

pmc-13199991.title: Solitary Testicular Metastasis From Ductal Prostate Cancer 5 Years After Radical Prostatectomy: A Case Report
pmc-13199991.creator: Martina Romani, Tonino Morena, Denise Bianchi, Chiara Ogliosi, Alberto Pettenò, Alberto Zaniboni, Angelo Peroni, Kalyani Sen
pmc-13199991.description: Testicular metastases from prostate carcinoma are exceedingly uncommon, particularly from the ductal histological subtype, which is associated with aggressive clinical behavior and a propensity for atypical metastatic dissemination. We report the case of a 73‐year‐old male with a history of prostate ductal adenocarcinoma (PDA) treated in 2018 with robot‐assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP) and extended pelvic lymphadenectomy.

pmc-13212582.title: Unraveling volcanic impacts in semi-arid climates: machine learning and CMIP6 insights from Krakatau and Santa Maria
pmc-13212582.creator: Abdolazim Saman, Gholamreza Roshan, Stefan W. Grab, Muhammad Mubashar Dogar, Tarig A. Ali
pmc-13212582.description: Volcanic eruptions are among the strongest natural climate forcings, yet their regional impacts remain poorly resolved, particularly in semi-arid hotspots. Here, we investigate the climatic fingerprints of the Krakatau (1883) and Santa Maria (1902) eruptions on surface temperatures over Iran by integrating CMIP6 multi-model simulations with Random Forest machine learning.

pmc-13486369.title: Prevalence and risk factors of ovine haemonchosis in Kutaber district, north-east Ethiopia
pmc-13486369.creator: Paulos Gashaw Admass, Assaye Wollelie Fentie, Animaw Andargie Worku, Asmamaw Bihonegn Desale, Teketay Bayleyegn Derso, Yihenew Getahun Ambaw, Zemenu Tsehay Bogale, Assaye Desta Amare
pmc-13486369.description: BackgroundOvine haemonchosis is a widespread parasitic disease of sheep in Ethiopia, and understanding its prevalence and associated risk factors in Kutaber district is important for effective control.MethodsThe research was cross-sectional study conducted from December 2023 to May 2024 at kutaber district, North Eastern Ethiopia with the objectives to determine prevalence of ovine haemoncosis and investigating potential associated risk factors.

pmc-13537829.title: Advances in genomics-driven genetic decoding and genomic design breeding in tomato
pmc-13537829.creator: Zihui Ding, Zhangjun Fei, Sanwen Huang, Yaoyao Wu
pmc-13537829.description: Tomatoes are highly nutritious and represent one of the important vegetable fruits worldwide. Both historically and moving forward, genetic decoding and precision breeding remain fundamental to tomato improvement. Here, we summarize pivotal advances in decoding tomato genomes across domestication, improvement and evolution processes and provide a perspective on future breeding through precision design.
